snippet.title: VOIDFALL - Horror Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
➤  WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4345950/VOIDCAST/

VOIDCAST is an atmospheric horror experience that drops you into an abandoned video store after dark, where reality begins to unravel. Explore liminal spaces, solve environmental puzzles, and descend deeper into the unknown, but remember, not every path is meant to be escaped. 

Featuring PS1-style graphics, liminal spaces, atmospheric horror, easter eggs and interactions, Steam Achievements and 1–2 hours of gameplay, guided by your curiosity and choices. 

Possible release: Q4 2026 or early.
(Still working hard to make the best game!)

Contact/Inquiries : gamedevbodwin@gmail.com

--
